title: If you’re a fashion or jewellery brand stuck on content ideas for ads...
description: If you’re a fashion or jewellery brand stuck on content ideas for ads, this is for you.  #metaadstips #facebookcreative #metaadsspecialist #metaads #fashionmarketing
transcript: If you're a fashion or jewellery brand stuck on what content to make for your ads, this one's for you. And trust me, it's not another product shop. Most founders I speak to have the exact same problem. They know their current content strategy isn't performing, but when it comes time to come up with something different, they go blank. So they default back to what they know best. Flat lays, maybe the Lysel content, the 20% off graphics, and the cycle repeats. The issue isn't creativity. It's that nobody shows them a different starting point. In my agency, we use a 10 bucket creative framework built around psychology and funnel stages. Here are three non typical types, ones I'm actually building right now for my clients. Where were you wearing it? Not a product review, an actual story. You can ask a customer or a creator one question. Where were you wearing it when something important happened? The necklace that maybe she wore at the job interview, the ring that maybe she bought after a hard year. You're not selling a product. You're collecting evidence that your brand showed up for people in their real lives. That converts completely different. The take it off problem book could be, I shouldn't have to choose between wearing my jewellery everyday and living my life. Show the frustration taking it off before the gym, maybe the shower, the pool, work, then introduce the product that ends that negotiation. For solid gold pieces, This angle is massively underused. The emotional payoff, I can just wear it and not have to think about it, is more powerful than any product spec that you write in your ad copy. The accidental compliment trail, not a review of the product, a review of how other people responded to it. For example, I got stopped three times walking down the street because of the necklace I was wearing. This is more convincing than a direct testimonial because it proves the piece performs in the real world, not just someone's opinion. I've got 17 more of these in a full episode on my marketing podcast called Marketing Mate. It's available on Spotify now.
